parameters.query: SELECT e.id, e.name, e.hourly_rate, e.salary_type, SUM(a.hours_worked) as total_hours, COUNT(a.id) as days_worked FROM employees e JOIN attendance a ON e.id = a.employee_id WHERE a.work_date >= date_trunc('month', NOW() - INTERVAL '1 month') AND a.work_date < date_trunc('month', NOW()) GROUP BY e.id, e.name, e.hourly_rate, e.salary_type
